verdict: THE BRIDGE DIFFERENCE SURVIVES AT THE SITE LEVEL, AND THE SEEDS TURN OUT TO BE CLONES. Over five distinct sites per level the warm level's contact-moment bridge ratio is 0.19346 against 0.36295 for the cold (difference -0.16949, registered bar -0.05), and the order is nearly complete: four of the five warm sites ([0.138, 0.138, 0.138, 0.154, 0.399]) lie below every cold site, whose lowest is 0.184; the exact Mann-Whitney one-sided p is 0.0159. The radius-3 arm moves the other way again (0.31715 against 0.24629, +0.07086, p = 0.9246), consistent with X189 and with the outcome (3 of 5 against 0 of 5). The registered within-site-spread check FAILED and is a finding rather than a design gap: the three seeds of a site give identical ratios (sd 0.0), because at eps=0 the seed enters only through the initial condition, so same-site seeds are one world repeated. Every seed-level group in X187-X189 therefore had 1-2 distinct worlds at most, which is why X187's radius-6 p of 0.39 and X189's single-site warm arm were weak: the unit of replication in this line is the SITE, not the seed.
